args.rationale:
The recommendation to purchase 800 units should be rejected. Placing a new order for 800 units would cost $12,000.00 with SUP-A or $14,000.00 with SUP-B, both of which exceed the available budget limit of $10,000.00 and are infeasible.

Analysis shows current usable inventory is 1,000 units against a daily forecast of 100 units/day. Without intervention, inventory runs out on 2026-09-27, resulting in 400 units of unmet demand across 4 days (2026-09-27 to 2026-09-30). Confirmed purchase order PO-501 (2,000 units) is scheduled to arrive on 2026-10-01.

Expedite options from supplier SUP-A allow PO-501 to be brought forward by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 for an expedite fee of $450.00. Simulation confirms that expediting PO-501 to 2026-09-27 eliminates 100% of the projected unmet demand (0 residual unmet units) at an incremental cost of $450.00, while staying fully within the $10,000.00 budget and 200 m³ warehouse capacity limits.

Note: The $450.00 expedite fee exceeds the buyer autonomy limit of $250.00, so this action will require buyer approval, but it represents the most cost-effective and feasible solution.
important_factors: The purchasing system recommendation to buy 800 units ($12,000 with SUP-A or $14,000 with SUP-B) exceeds the available budget limit of $10,000.00 and is infeasible.
Current usable stock is 1,000 units. With a forecast of 100 units/day, stockout occurs on 2026-09-27, creating a 4-day shortage gap of 400 units prior to PO-501's original arrival date of 2026-10-01.
Existing open order PO-501 (2,000 units with SUP-A) can be expedited by 4 days to 2026-09-27 for an expedite fee of $450.00.
Expedite action eliminates all 400 units of projected unmet demand at a total cost of $450.00, well within the $10,000.00 budget and capacity limits.
PO-501 partial confirmation yielded 1200 units instead of 2000 units (800 cancelled), leaving 600 units of unmet demand between 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-14.
The system recommended ordering 800 units, but at $15.00/unit this costs $12,000.00, which breaches the available budget limit of $9,550.00.
Ordering 600 units from SUP-A costs $9,000.00, which is within available budget ($9,550.00) and completely resolves all 600 units of unmet demand.
assumptions: SUP-A can deliver 600 units by 2026-09-24 as per quote lead time of 7 days.
args.rationale: The prior expedite of PO-501 resulted in partial confirmation of 1,200 units and 800 cancelled units, creating a projected shortage of 600 units between 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-14. The system recommendation to order 800 units is infeasible as its total cost ($12,000.00 at SUP-A's unit price of $15.00) exceeds the available budget limit of $9,550.00 by $2,450.00. Modifying the order quantity to 600 units from SUP-A at $15.00 per unit requires $9,000.00, staying within the available budget of $9,550.00. Arriving on 2026-09-24 (7 days lead time), this order completely eliminates the 600 units of unmet demand over the planning horizon.
